# glyhub

glyhub collects glycomics and glycoproteomics data for the Glycoverse
ecosystem, using the
[`GlycomicSE`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyexp/reference/GlycomicSE.html)
and
[`GlycoproteomicSE`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyexp/reference/GlycoproteomicSE.html)
containers from [glyexp](https://github.com/glycoverse/glyexp). The
package is experimental.

## Available data

Eleven glycomics objects are bundled from two public studies. No
glycoproteomics datasets are included yet.

| Dataset                       | Features × observations |
|-------------------------------|-------------------------|
| `glyhub_GPST000738_N_B4GalT1` | 9 × 18                  |
| `glyhub_GPST000738_N_ST6GAL1` | 10 × 28                 |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_O_S5`      | 108 × 22                |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_O_S7`      | 77 × 6                  |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_O_S9B`     | 56 × 7                  |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_O_S10B`    | 9 × 8                   |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_N_S10B`    | 3 × 8                   |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_O_S10C`    | 3 × 15                  |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_N_S10C`    | 2 × 15                  |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_O_S11B`    | 60 × 9                  |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_O_S12`     | 140 × 4                 |

GPST000738 retains both enzyme experiments and all raw-table feature
rows. Conflicting cells are NA; this is not a complete reconstruction of
the authors’ final analytical matrix. Flow and time are conditions, and
a repeated control table is represented once per enzyme. Unmatched
processed-table observations remain in metadata without invented sample
pairing.

GPST000643 uses complete supplementary quantitative tables for separate
experiments. Tables S10B and S10C have distinct N/O feature spaces and
are split accordingly. Each pair retains the same source observation
columns and original denominators. Source labels do not establish
biological replication or cross-table pairing.

**Zero-valued abundances are stored as NA in the distributed assays.**
Original values, source n.d./NA, conflict masks and zero-to-NA records
are retained separately in metadata. Metadata zeros (such as 0 hours)
are unchanged. Measurements are not imputed or renormalized. Read the
[curation audit](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyhub/data-raw/AUDIT.md)
for source selection, units, annotation precision, licenses and
limitations.

## Installation

Install the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/glycoverse/glyhub):

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("glycoverse/glyhub")
```

## Example

``` r

x <- glyhub::glyhub_GPST000738_N_B4GalT1
dim(x)
#> [1]  9 18
data.frame(as.list(S4Vectors::metadata(x)$processing_counts))
#>   source_missing source_nd conflict zero_to_na
#> 1              0         0       24          6
```

Data use R’s LazyData mechanism. `SummarizedExperiment::assay(x)`
contains the curated abundance matrix;
`S4Vectors::metadata(x)$raw_abundance` preserves the unconverted values.
`rowData(x)` retains typed glyrepr annotations and source evidence, and
`colData(x)` retains source conditions and observation locations.

## Reproduction

Original inputs and scripts are grouped by accession under
`data-raw/GPST000643/` and `data-raw/GPST000738/`. From the package
root:

``` r

source("data-raw/build.R")
# Check that rebuilding preserves scientific contents:
source("data-raw/validate-reproduction.R")
```

See [validation
results](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyhub/data-raw/VALIDATION.md).
See
[`?glyhub_data_conventions`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyhub/reference/glyhub_data_conventions.md)
for shared measurement and annotation conventions.

# Package index

## Curated glycomics data

- [`glyhub_GPST000738_N_B4GalT1`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyhub/reference/glyhub_GPST000738_N_B4GalT1.md)
  : Galactosylation of bovine fetuin N-glycans in an enzyme reactor
- [`glyhub_GPST000738_N_ST6GAL1`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyhub/reference/glyhub_GPST000738_N_ST6GAL1.md)
  : Sialylation of bovine fetuin N-glycans in an enzyme reactor
- [`glyhub_GPST000643_O_S5`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyhub/reference/glyhub_GPST000643_O_S5.md)
  : Fucosidase treatment of porcine colonic mucin O-glycans
- [`glyhub_GPST000643_O_S7`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyhub/reference/glyhub_GPST000643_O_S7.md)
  : GH89 treatment of porcine gastric mucin O-glycans
- [`glyhub_GPST000643_O_S9B`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyhub/reference/glyhub_GPST000643_O_S9B.md)
  : GH2 treatment of bovine submaxillary mucin O-glycans
- [`glyhub_GPST000643_O_S10B`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyhub/reference/glyhub_GPST000643_O_S10B.md)
  : GH20 activity on O-glycans from pretreated PSGL-1
- [`glyhub_GPST000643_N_S10B`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyhub/reference/glyhub_GPST000643_N_S10B.md)
  : GH20 activity on N-glycans from pretreated PSGL-1
- [`glyhub_GPST000643_O_S10C`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyhub/reference/glyhub_GPST000643_O_S10C.md)
  : Replicated GH20 measurements of PSGL-1 O-glycan core features
- [`glyhub_GPST000643_N_S10C`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyhub/reference/glyhub_GPST000643_N_S10C.md)
  : Replicated GH20 measurements of PSGL-1 N-glycan features
- [`glyhub_GPST000643_O_S11B`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyhub/reference/glyhub_GPST000643_O_S11B.md)
  : Colonic mucin O-glycan degradation by enzyme mixtures
- [`glyhub_GPST000643_O_S12`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyhub/reference/glyhub_GPST000643_O_S12.md)
  : Gastric mucin oligosaccharides remaining after bacterial growth

## Data conventions

- [`glyhub_data_conventions`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyhub/reference/glyhub_data_conventions.md)
  : Measurement and annotation conventions for glyhub datasets
